lines.zh: 我身上的条纹，一半就断了。
斑纹在草浪里忽隐忽现
lines.en: Its stripes fade in and out of the grass.
It trots a stretch along the riverbank.

lines.zh: 停一下，再低头啃两口草
lines.en: It stops, then ducks for two bites of grass.
A hoof sinks into soft soil and pulls free.

lines.zh: 尾巴甩开围上来的蝇虫
lines.en: Its tail flicks off the gathering flies.

lines.zh: 它带着小斑驴走在前头
lines.en: It leads the young quagga ahead.

lines.zh: 站在树荫下，耳朵不停转
lines.en: It stands in the shade, ears swiveling.

lines.zh: 半边身子是条纹，半边是褐毛
lines.en: Half striped, half brown-coated, it stands.
It rests its chin on the fence.

lines.zh: 一动不动，只有尾巴在动

lines.en: Stripes flickering, I keep my eyes on you.

lines.zh: 它的皮毛像斑马，但肉质鲜美。
lines.en: Its fur like a zebra, but the meat is delicious.
You really want to taste its meat?

lines.zh: 它不会攻击，但可以食用。
lines.en: It won't attack, but it can be eaten.

lines.zh: 它的肉对你的生存大有帮助。
lines.en: Its meat is helpful for your survival.

lines.zh: 尝试驯服它，以获取更好的肉质。
lines.en: Try taming it for better meat quality.

lines.zh: 不要伤害它，只需尝试驯服。
lines.en: Don't harm it, just try to tame it.

lines.zh: 它的肉质鲜美，适合烧烤。
lines.en: The meat is delicious, perfect for roasting.

lines.zh: 它的肉是生存的好选择。
lines.en: Its meat is a good choice for survival.

lines.zh: 它的肉比其他史前生物更美味。
lines.en: Its meat is more delicious than other prehistoric creatures.

lines.zh: 它会受惊逃跑，你撞到了它。
lines.en: It will run away in fright when you collide with it.

lines.zh: 你撞到了它的硬皮，它痛苦地叫唤。
lines.en: You hit its tough hide, causing it to call out in pain.
Be careful, it will run away in fright.
It quickly runs away in fright.

lines.zh: 你撞到了它，它愤怒地嘶鸣。
lines.en: You hit it, causing it to snort in anger.

lines.zh: 它的身体强壮，不会轻易倒下。
lines.en: Its body is strong, it won't easily fall.

lines.zh: 你撞到了它，它试图逃跑。
lines.en: You hit it, and it tries to run away.

lines.zh: 你撞到了它的腿，它叫得更响了。
lines.en: You hit its leg, and it calls out louder.

lines.zh: 它只会被动地生活，不求伴侣。
lines.en: It only passively lives, not seeking a mate.
It does not seek a mate.
It does not mate with others of its kind.
It does not court or reproduce.
It has no instinct for courting.

lines.zh: 它的繁殖行为极为罕见。
lines.en: Its reproductive behavior is extremely rare.

lines.zh: 它仅被动生活，不求伴侣。
lines.en: It only lives passively, not seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 我的皮毛如此坚硬，适合奔跑！
lines.en: My tough hide is perfect for running!

lines.zh: 我只需吃植物，不需要其他。
lines.en: I only need plants; no more needed.

lines.zh: 这片沼泽是我的家园，很安全。
lines.en: This swamp is my safe home.

lines.zh: 我的体型庞大，难以被猎杀。
lines.en: My large size makes me hard to hunt.

lines.zh: 这些植物营养丰富，适合我。
lines.en: These plants are rich and good.

lines.zh: 沼泽中的微生物是我的食物。
lines.en: The swamp’s microbes are my food.

lines.zh: 我在这片沼泽中自由奔跑。
lines.en: I run freely in this swamp.

lines.zh: 我只会吃植物，从不啃食泥土。
lines.en: I eat plants; no soil digging.

lines.zh: 我感受到了危险的气息。
我需要找到一个隐蔽之处。
我的速度可以让我逃脱。
你一抬手，我就先退两步。
lines.en: The moment you raise a hand, I back off two steps.

lines.zh: 它抬头，耳朵一齐朝向你
lines.en: It lifts its head, both ears toward you.
It backs off half a step, ready to bolt.

lines.zh: 斑纹一抖，我已经准备跑。
lines.en: My stripes twitch; I am ready to run.

lines.zh: 我只会选择最安全的路径。
我不会主动挑衅任何人。
它侧过身，把你留在视线里
lines.en: It turns side-on, keeping you in sight.

lines.zh: 肌肉绷紧，却没有冲过来
lines.en: Its muscles tense, but it does not charge.

lines.zh: 它选了离你更远的那条路
lines.en: It picks the path further from you.

lines.zh: 我这一身条纹，跑起来更难抓。
lines.en: With these stripes, I'm harder to catch running.
I kick with my hind legs; pure instinct.
Startled, it kicks up its hooves and runs.

lines.zh: 草原上，多了一匹条纹的。
lines.en: One more striped animal on the plain.

lines.zh: 化石坑旁站起一头斑驴
lines.en: A quagga stands up beside the dig pit.

lines.zh: 它从草原边缘慢慢走来
lines.en: It wanders in from the edge of the plains.
A herd of quaggas splashes across the shallows.

lines.zh: 幼崽跟在母兽身后现身
lines.en: A foal appears behind the mare.

lines.zh: 栏杆外，它探头望向这边
lines.en: Beyond the fence, it pokes its head this way.
